items.title: Eddie B. Edwards Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Nick wished to go to New Orleans so we did... Nick and Tony they got a big band together

ctx.x: all had nice uh qualities about them and after you had this band going with Seberg and uh Vanaselli what happened

then we played at the Balkan Aids till about 19 uh 25 and Nick wished to go to New Orleans so we did and then uh I stopped the band for a while and I got an engagement at the Silver Slipper where we had uh shows and I had uh eleven men with a jazz band in the big band was in the band you uh worked there for two years
yes did you replace anybody uh did you replace Nick with anybody in a five piece band did you
